rows.commentary: 0.1: Kim Garth charges in to deliver the opening ball, sliding it neatly into the covers where Laura Wolvaardt calls for a sharp single to get off the mark.
0.2: Maia Bouchier does not score off Kim Garth.
13.3: Annabel Sutherland slides into the attack, clipped away sharply by Tahlia McGrath into the vast expanses of deep mid-wicket for a single.
13.4: Annabel Sutherland tests the line again, punched deftly by Laura Wolvaardt toward the cover region to rotate the strike.
13.5: Dot ball from Annabel Sutherland to Tahlia McGrath.
13.6: Annabel Sutherland gets pulled away violently by Tahlia McGrath, finding the mid-wicket fence for a boundary as the partnership continues to build.
14.1: Kim Garth drops it on a length, worked away neatly by Laura Wolvaardt into the mid-wicket pocket for one run.
14.2: Tahlia McGrath does not score off Kim Garth.
14.3: Kim Garth serves it up, swept firmly by Tahlia McGrath out to deep mid-wicket to comfortably collect a single.
14.4: Kim Garth hits the pitch hard, nudged smoothly by Laura Wolvaardt toward mid-wicket to pick up another run.
14.5: No run for Tahlia McGrath off Kim Garth.
14.6: Kim Garth floats this one through, driven down the ground by Tahlia McGrath toward long-off for a brisk single.
15.1: Sophie Day drops into the attack, swept powerfully by Tahlia McGrath into the deep mid-wicket grass for one.
15.2: Sophie Day offers too much air, lofted majestically over long-off by Laura Wolvaardt for a gorgeous boundary.
15.3: Sophie Day strays in length, deposited with authority by Laura Wolvaardt away to the deep mid-wicket boundary.
15.4: Sophie Day absorbs heavy pressure as Laura Wolvaardt ruthlessly dispatches another delivery into the deep mid-wicket ropes.
15.5: Sophie Day pulls back the length, tucked around the corner by Laura Wolvaardt towards mid-wicket for a single.
15.6: Sophie Day offers flight, and Tahlia McGrath punishes it with a crisp drive racing away to the deep extra cover fence.
Laura Wolvaardt is putting on a show, smashing three consecutive boundaries to elevate her score to 64!
16.1: Danielle Gibson spears this in, clipped away smartly by Laura Wolvaardt toward deep mid-wicket for a single.
4.4: Rhys McKenna does not score off Madeline Penna.
4.5: Madeline Penna loops it up to Rhys McKenna, who guides the ball toward cover and scampers across for a single.
4.6: Madeline Penna delivers to Meg Lanning, who works it out toward sweeper cover to rotate the strike with a single.
5.1: Tahlia McGrath pitches it up to Meg Lanning, who dispatches the ball fine down to the boundary for four runs.
5.2: Tahlia McGrath targets Meg Lanning, who works the ball away toward backward square leg and scampers back for a hard-run two.
5.3: Meg Lanning does not score off Tahlia McGrath.
5.4: Tahlia McGrath bangs it in toward Meg Lanning, who neatly redirects it away to backward square leg for four.
5.5: No run for Meg Lanning off Tahlia McGrath.
5.6: Tahlia McGrath drifts one wide to Meg Lanning, who opens the face and steers it down to third man for a boundary.
6.1: Amanda-Jade Wellington drops it short to Rhys McKenna, who pulls the ball firmly out to deep mid-wicket for a single.
6.2: Amanda-Jade Wellington flights it up to Meg Lanning, who sweeps it brilliantly away to fine leg for four.
6.3: Dot ball from Amanda-Jade Wellington to Meg Lanning.
6.4: No run for Meg Lanning off Amanda-Jade Wellington.
6.5: A leg bye off Amanda-Jade Wellington's delivery to Meg Lanning.
6.6: Amanda-Jade Wellington tosses it up to Rhys McKenna, who drives the ball toward sweeper cover and completes a single.
7.1: Larosa drifts one wide, allowing McKenna to slice a delicate boundary down to third man.
7.2: Larosa keeps it tight, forcing McKenna to turn the ball briskly away toward square leg for a single.
7.3: Eleanor Larosa delivers to Meg Lanning, pushed out into the deep mid-wicket region for a single.
17.3: Amanda-Jade Wellington tosses it up, and Naomi Stalenberg punishes it cleanly to the deep extra cover fence for four.
17.4: Amanda-Jade Wellington strays again, allowing Naomi Stalenberg to swipe it firmly away toward deep mid-wicket for another boundary.
17.5: Amanda-Jade Wellington pulls her length back slightly, and Naomi Stalenberg nurdles it into the mid-wicket region to rotate the strike.
17.6: Amanda-Jade Wellington drops it into the arc, and Kim Garth clips it neatly toward mid-wicket to pick up a single.
18.1: Sophie Ecclestone drops onto a length, and Kim Garth sweeps it out into the deep mid-wicket grass for one.
18.2: A bye off Sophie Ecclestone's delivery to Naomi Stalenberg.
18.3: Sophie Ecclestone slides it onto the pads, allowing Kim Garth to push it toward mid-wicket for a sharp single.
18.4: Sophie Ecclestone finds the breakthrough as Naomi Stalenberg skies one straight to Eleanor Larosa to depart for a belligerent 32.
18.5: Sophie Ecclestone fires it in at the stumps, and Carly Leeson nudges it into the mid-wicket pocket to scamper a single.
18.6: Sophie Ecclestone offers width, and Kim Garth capitalizes with a gorgeous drive piercing deep extra cover for four.
19.1: Carly Leeson does not score off Eleanor Larosa.
19.2: Eleanor Larosa lands it full, and Carly Leeson turns it firmly into the mid-wicket gap to hustle back for a comfortable couple.
19.3: Eleanor Larosa digs into the surface, and Carly Leeson belts it away toward deep mid-wicket to collect a single.
19.4: Eleanor Larosa attacks the stumps, but Kim Garth carves it piercingly away to the sweeper cover boundary for four.
19.5: Eleanor Larosa steams in and fires it down, turning into a single squeezed out to the deep mid-wicket boundary by Kim Garth.
19.6: No run for Carly Leeson off Eleanor Larosa.
